components.name: Save Button
components.description: The solid ink primary action, carrying the save ring: hollow while unsaved, filled when the file matches the board.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:34px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; line-height:1; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s, transform .1s; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #111111; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--ink, #111111); color:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#2a2a2a; } .ds-btn-save { padding:0 15px 0 12px; } .ds-ring { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--accent, #b5d334); background:transparent; transition:background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-save.is-synced .ds-ring { background:var(--accent, #b5d334); }

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:34px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d2d2d2); border-radius:9px; background:var(--s0, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #111111); font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s, transform .1s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#b9b9b9; background:var(--s1, #fafafa); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #111111; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Transparent destructive action in the card sheet foot.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:34px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:var(--danger, #b42318); font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:var(--danger-wash, #fdecea); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #111111; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline field; focus turns the border to ink with a faint halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width:260px; height:34px; padding:0 11px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d2d2d2); border-radius:9px; background:var(--s0, #ffffff); color:#111111; font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:14px; transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#707070; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--ink, #111111); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(17,17,17,.07); }

components.name: File Chip
components.description: Top-bar chip naming the open file; the quiet dashed variant marks sample content.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:26px; padding:0 9px; border:1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:8px; background:var(--s0, #ffffff); color:var(--ink-2, #3d3d3d); font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-chip-quiet { background:transparent; border-style:dashed; border-color:var(--line-strong, #d2d2d2); color:var(--muted, #6b6b6b); }

components.css: .ds-ground { padding:20px 24px; background:#efefef; font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); color:#111111; } .ds-list { width:280px; background:var(--s1, #fafafa); border:1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(17,17,17,.04), 0 14px 30px -24px rgba(17,17,17,.22); } .ds-list-head { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 12px 6px 14px; } .ds-list-head h3 { margin:0; flex:1; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; } .ds-count { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#6b6b6b; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-cards { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:4px 8px 2px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; } .ds-card { background:#ffffff; border:1px solid var(--line-card, #e6e6e6); border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(17,17,17,.05); padding:9px 11px 10px 12px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#d2d2d2; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgba(17,17,17,.14), 0 1px 2px rgba(17,17,17,.05); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #111111; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-card p { margin:0; font-size:14px; line-height:1.42; } .ds-labels { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; margin:1px 0 7px; } .ds-lbl { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:20px; padding:0 7px; border-radius:6px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.005em; } .ds-blue { background:#e2ebfb; color:#1f4fa3; } .ds-yellow { background:#faf0c6; color:#735708; } .ds-orange { background:#fde7d4; color:#984a0c; } .ds-add { display:flex; align-items:center; width:calc(100% - 16px); margin:6px 8px 8px; height:34px; padding:0 9px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:none; color:#555555; font:inherit; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-add:hover { background:rgba(17,17,17,.05); color:#111111; }

components.name: Menu
components.description: Popover menu with icon rows, a divider and a danger item.
components.css: .ds-menu { width:230px; padding:6px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 12px 28px -12px rgba(17,17,17,.24), 0 2px 6px rgba(17,17,17,.06); font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-mi { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; height:34px; padding:0 10px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:none; color:#111111; font:inherit; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-mi svg { color:#6b6b6b; flex:none; } .ds-mi:hover, .ds-mi:focus-visible { background:var(--s2, #f3f3f3); outline:none; } .ds-kbd { margin-left:auto; font-size:12px; font-weight:400; color:#6b6b6b; } .ds-mi-danger, .ds-mi-danger svg { color:var(--danger, #b42318); } .ds-menu hr { border:0; border-top:1px solid #e4e4e4; margin:6px 4px; }

components.name: Drop Slot and Drag Ghost
components.description: The lifted card under the pointer and the chartreuse slot where it will land.
components.html: Order a 5 inch freestyle frame
components.css: .ds-drag { width:264px; padding:16px 8px; background:#fafafa; border-radius:14px; display:grid; gap:8px; font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-ghost { padding:9px 11px 10px 12px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #d2d2d2; border-radius:10px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.42; color:#111111; rotate:1.75deg; scale:1.025; box-shadow:0 16px 30px -12px rgba(17,17,17,.30), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(17,17,17,.10); transition:rotate .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), scale .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-ghost:hover { rotate:0deg; scale:1; } .ds-slot { height:56px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent-wash, #f2f7dd); border:1.5px dashed var(--accent-line, #a3c037); }

components.description: Ink bar at bottom centre with an underlined inline action.
components.css: .ds-toast { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:42px; padding:9px 9px 9px 14px; background:var(--ink, #111111); color:#f2f2f2; border-radius:11px; font-family:var(--font, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:13.5px; box-shadow:0 14px 34px -12px rgba(17,17,17,.45); } .ds-toast button { border:0; background:transparent; color:#fff; font:inherit; font-weight:700; padding:5px 9px; border-radius:7px; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); text-underline-offset:3px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-toast button:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); text-decoration-color:#fff; } .ds-toast button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
The board is a precision tool on a desk in daylight: a quiet grey field, white cards resting on pale columns, and near-black ink. Everything structural (ground, lists, cards, controls, chrome) is drawn from one neutral scale running from pure white to #111111. Colour is reserved for information. Labels carry their meaning in tinted pills, and a single chartreuse accent marks what is live: the save-state ring, the slot a dragged card will land in, a file dragged over the cover dropzone, and text selection.

Density is Trello-quick rather than airy: 280px columns, 8px gaps between cards, 34px controls, 14px body text. Depth is soft and physical (hairlines plus low, diffuse shadows), and motion is short and eased with one curve. The signature behaviours are the lifted drag card, which tilts and grows slightly under a deeper shadow while its neighbours reflow, and the save ring, which is hollow while the board differs from the file and fills when they match.

The build rejects a coloured wallpaper behind floating tiles and any brand colour washed across surfaces. The ground stays grey and the chrome stays neutral.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral scale for all structure; colour only where it carries information.
A single chartreuse accent, always meaning "live" or "landing here".
Satoshi at three weights (400, 500, 700), with tabular figures for counts and status.
1px hairlines and soft, diffuse shadows; radii from 6px to 14px that grow with the size of the container.
Solid near-black primary action; white hairline ghosts for everything secondary.

rules.name: The Information-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only where it says something: a label, the save state, a drop target, danger. Every surface, border and control that is not one of those stays on the neutral ramp.

rules.name: The Live Accent Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse means "live now" or "this lands here". It never decorates, never fills a resting surface, and never sits on a button background. It shows as the save ring inside the black button, or as a wash plus edge on a target.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Use only 400, 500 and 700, the three embedded cuts. Bold is reserved for titles (board, list, card sheet); controls speak at 500.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts and save status use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so they don't shift width when the numbers change.

rules.name: The Rise With Intent Rule
rules.body: The shadow deepens only with the object's state: rest, hover, popover, lift. A surface never wears a deeper shadow than its role calls for.

dos: Do build every surface, border and control from the neutral ramp, from Paper White (#ffffff) to Ink (#111111).
Do reserve chartreuse for live state: the save ring, drop slots and drop targets, and text selection.
Do keep one solid ink primary button per surface; everything else is a hairline ghost, a link or an icon button.
Do use soft, ink-tinted, downward shadows that deepen with state (rest, hover, pop, lift).
Do use dashed hairlines for space that can be filled (add list, dropzone, drop slot, sample marker).
Do use tabular figures for counts and save status.
Do use the shared curve `cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1)` and keep motion under 300ms, except the 420ms save-ring pop.
donts: Don't put a brand or accent colour on a resting surface, a ground, or a button fill; the ground stays Desk Grey.
Don't use label tints for chrome; they belong to labels only.
Don't use Satoshi weights other than 400, 500 and 700; only those three are embedded.
Don't use hard-edged or zero-blur offset shadows; depth here is diffuse.
Don't add a second typeface; hierarchy comes from weight and size within Satoshi.
